description: Move clips that pin a retired TSX (version 3) component to its native (version 4) successor: the `successorSourceVersionId` that get_composition's `needsUpgrade` (or a `component_source_retired` refusal) names. Pass projectId and, in `body`, optional `clip_ids` (omit them to move every clip that has a successor) and `composition_id` (the active composition when omitted). Saved inputs are kept. The answer lists `moved` and `withoutSuccessor`; rebuild the latter as native components (create_component, then apply_composition at the same timing and placement).

clip_ids.description: The clips (component placements) to move. Omit to move every clip that has a native successor.

composition_id.description: The composition to update; the project's active one when omitted.

name: repin_component

withoutSuccessor.description: Clips pinning a retired TSX source no curated release shipped: rebuild them as native components.

title: Repin Component
